docs.title: Dd clone via ssh
docs.text:
Clone Image

# Clone remotely
ssh root@192.168.170.10 "dd if=/dev/sdb | gzip -1 -" | dd of=sdb_system.gz

docs.title: Better cat (bat)
docs.text:
Better cat (bat) is so much more convinient for daily usage than cat, especially if your most side tasks are on a Linux / WSL2 shell.

  • Install: sudo apt install bat
  • Usage: batcat

docs.title: Usage tipps
docs.text:
• bat uses cat | less by default
  • Ppen the context meni with :
  • Search for strings with :/

docs.title: Tip
docs.text: Alias batcat to bat to be faster on typing: alias bat="batcat". Add this in your ~/.profile or ~/.bashrc (bash) or ~/.zprofile or ~/.zshrc (zsh). I prefer having an custom ~/.aliasrc file which is sourced in ~/.zshrc.
